card_text: A burst fade for Hobbs summers: skin around the ear, curls kept, cut 70 miles west in Carlsbad.

seo.title: Burst Fade for Hobbs, NM | Divinely Faded, Carlsbad
seo.description: Burst fades for Hobbs, cut in Carlsbad about 80 minutes west. Why the arc suits a Lea County summer, what to book and how it grows between trips.

paragraphs: A burst fade drops to skin in a half-circle around the ear and fans out from there, leaving the back with real length. My shop is in Carlsbad, not Hobbs: {{city:hobbs.drive_mi}} miles of {{city:hobbs.route}} sit between us, about {{city:hobbs.drive_min}} minutes behind the wheel each way.
Below: why the burst suits a Lea County summer, what to book, and how the arc behaves between trips.

blocks.heading: Skin where it counts, length where you want it.
paragraphs: Hobbs sees roughly {{city:hobbs.days_100f}} days a year at 100°F or hotter, with a typical July high of {{city:hobbs.july_high_f}} (Open-Meteo, 2023–25). Carlsbad, where you'll be sitting in my chair, runs warmer still at {{city:carlsbad.july_high_f}}.

If you want bare skin around the ears for those months without giving up the curls or the hair at the nape, a burst is the compromise: the arc clears the hair where a cap presses, and the back keeps its weight.

blocks.heading: The arc goes soft. The back doesn't.
paragraphs: The half-circle is the shortest part of the cut, so it loses its edge first; the length behind it looks deliberate for a good while longer. Want the curve crisp all the time? Plan the trips closer together. Fine with a softer arc? It still reads as a burst well after the skin has grown in.

items.title: Essential Haircut
items.body: The burst around the ear, curls shaped on top, back left long, straight razor along the neckline.

items.title: Signature Cut
items.body: Adds the beard, a short clean cheek line and a hot towel to close.

items.q: Is a burst fade a sensible pick for the Hobbs heat?
items.a: If you want some skin for the hot months without losing your curls or the length in back, yes. If cooling is the only goal, a skin fade takes more off.

items.q: Can the burst be paired with a mullet in back?
items.a: It can. That's the burst fade mullet, booked as the same Essential Haircut. Just tell me you want the back long.
